name: juracad
description: Describe a part in plain English and Claude builds it with JuraCAD's CAD engine — with assemblies and 2D drawings — then saves a .juracad file you can open and edit in JuraCAD.
long_description: JuraCAD is a free, open-source CAD app in your browser (https://gm7dha.github.io/JuraCAD/). With this extension, Claude can build parts for you step by step: sketches, extrudes, holes (M2–M12), fillets, chamfers, shells, patterns and mirrors, using JuraCAD's own geometry engine. It checks the part, can show you pictures of it, and saves a normal .juracad design in your JuraCAD folder. Open that file in JuraCAD and every feature and dimension can still be changed. It can also put parts together in assemblies (joined with mates like Fasten, Hinge and Slider, checked for clashes, shown exploded), make 2D drawings with views, sections, details, dimensions and a title block (saved as PDF, SVG or DXF), and export STL, 3MF and STEP files for printing or manufacturing. With Live with Claude, click Connect to Claude in JuraCAD (Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari — in Safari it opens a small link window to keep open) and Claude works on the design you have open there, while you watch; every change is one step you can undo. That link stays on your computer and only the JuraCAD website can use it. It only reads and writes files inside the folder you choose.

design_folder.title: Folder for your designs
design_folder.description: Where Claude saves your JuraCAD designs (and exported STL, 3MF and STEP files and drawings), and the only folder it can open designs from.
